title: Siege of El Arish
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Siege of El Arish", at revision 1372136661, opens: "The siege of El Arish was a successful siege by French forces under Napoleon Bonaparte against Ottoman forces under Mustafa Pasha. The French army, commanded by Jean Baptiste Kléber and Jean Reynier laid siege to the fortress of El Arish for nine days. The fortress finally fell to the French on 20 February 1799." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3485822, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1799 siege fought during French Invasion of Egypt". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
